| Schneider Electric | Technical Project Management  - Specialist Professional | India | April 1, 2026 | hybrid | internship | junior | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | PROJECT MANAGER – DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION (SALES & MARKETING) Exp - 13-15 yrs Location - Bangalore (Hybrid) ABOUT THE POSITION: Within the DCR Digital Sales & Marketing Experience team, we define the strategy around our digital Sales & Marketing environment (Sales and Marketing Stack). As the end-to-end owner of technology solutions in this scope, the ambition is to accelerate the digital transformation of Sales & Marketing activities, notably through the adoption of innovative technologies (automation, artificial intelligence, data analytics), to drive growth and enhance customer satisfaction. MISSION The Digital Transformation Project Manager supports the Program Manager and is accountable for meeting timelines, scope, quality, value creation, and budget for strategic and innovative initiatives designed to digitally transform Sales & Marketing practices. This includes the large-scale deployment of new digital solutions (e.g., AI tools, sales automation systems, advanced data platforms) for Schneider Electric’s sales and marketing teams across multiple target countries, with the objective of improving commercial performance and customer experience. Working in close coordination with the Program Manager and global and local teams (CXCT business and Digital), the Project Manager leads these transformation projects end-to-end, ensuring alignment with the company’s strategic objectives and acting as a trusted digital transformation partner for business teams. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Global project management Prepare and manage project deliverables and reporting for each initiative (country rollout plans, weekly progress reviews, project dashboards, etc.), ensuring completeness and quality in line with internal methodologies (e.g., DM1 gates, Open/Do phases, GoLive,…). Execution tracking and risk management Monitor project execution by systematically comparing actual progress against the plan, identifying potential risks (including data security and regulatory compliance risks), and proactively proposing corrective action plans to the Program Manager/Capability leaders/CXCT Team to ensure objectives are achieved. Stakeholder communication and alignment Manage communication and engagement with all stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Digital teams, Domain Teams, Countries, etc.), ensuring alignment across entities and clear visibility on project status, risks, and key milestones. Build and maintain strong relationships with global (Domain) and local (country) teams, fostering a collaborative environment that supports the smooth integration of digital solutions and new ways of working across Schneider Electric’s Sales & Marketing organizations. Data governance and compliance Systematically embed data governance, privacy protection, and cybersecurity principles into every project to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards when deploying intelligent solutions (AI tools, data platforms, etc.). Change management and adoption Drive user adoption of new solutions by planning and executing change management activities (communication, enablement, training) to maximize adoption rates, operational efficiency, and business benefits (productivity improvement, customer satisfaction, revenue growth). Track usage and value-creation indicators (adoption rates, efficiency gains, user satisfaction, ROI of deployed tools) to measure transformation success and adjust actions accordingly. Project coordination and governance Coordinate and facilitate regular synchronization meetings (project committees, status reviews/reporting, governance forums) with all stakeholders (project teams, sponsors, country leads, etc.) to ensure timely information sharing, collaborative issue resolution, and decision-making aligned with the transformation strategy. Priority and escalation management Act as the primary point of contact for all project-related escalations. Effectively manage competing priorities to rapidly resolve critical issues while maintaining transformation momentum and user engagement SKILLS: Highly organized, structured, pragmatic, and able to synthesize information. Demonstrates a strong ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently by prioritizing and maintaining order within complex projects. Ability to integrate diverse sources of information, distilling key insights and presenting them in a clear, cohesive manner for strategic decision-making. Excellent communication and collaborative leadership skills, with adaptability, creativity, and emotional intelligence to engage and influence cross-functional teams. Knowledge of advanced digital tools (CRM, marketing automation, data analytics), and a solid understanding of artificial intelligence, data science, and cybersecurity fundamentals. Significant experience in an international and matrixed environment, with the ability to navigate between business and digital/IT teams. Looking to make an IMPACT with your career? When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. | Schneider Electric | Application Engineer - ECAD | Bangalore | March 11, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Role Overview 1) The candidate is responsible for creating, managing and maintaining Electrical design data for various SE Product ranges in ECAD Tool 2) This includes developing accurage schematics, wiring diagrams and electrical docuentaiton using ECAD tool. Key Responsibilities ECAD Library Management Develop, Maintain and control ECAD Library content including symbols, macros, 2D/ 3D representations, parts data management Ensure consistency, naming conventions and classification Validate and release new components based on supplier datasheets and electrical design rules ECAD Process Leadership 1) Define and maintain ECAD standards, workflows, templates, and quality guidelines 2) Drive process improvements, automation scripts, macros, and API-based enhancements. 3) Collaborate with IT/application support teams on ECAD tool upgrades, database migration, license management, and system optimization. Cross-Functional Collaboration 1) Work with electrical engineers, mechanical teams, manufacturing, and quality to ensure design data meets product requirements. 2) Provide support and training to engineers on ECAD tools, library usage, and design workflows. 3) Collaborate with IT/application teams to implement ECAD updates, automation scripts, or tool integrations. Quality Compliance & Standards 1) Ensure designs comply with applicable standards (IEC, UL, EN, company‑specific guidelines) 2) Contribute to continuous improvement of ECAD processes, library governance, and workflow efficiency. | Schneider Electric | Lead, SAP SLT Analyst | Bangalore | February 4, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | What will you do? SLT Implementation & Configuration Lead setup, configuration, and activation of SLT replication for SAP and non-SAP source systems. Design and implement replication models including table-level replication, filtering, transformation rules, and performance tuning. Manage initial load, delta replication, and post-load corrections. What skills and capabilities will make you successful? 5–10 years of hands-on experience with SAP SLT implementation and support. Strong knowledge of data extraction, transformation, filtering, and performance tuning in SLT. Experience in supporting large-scale replication scenarios in multi-system landscapes. Deep understanding of SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and data structures across key modules. Proficiency in troubleshooting SLT triggers, logging tables, RFC connections, and HANA Studio. Ability to analyze data inconsistencies and provide effective resolution strategies. Strong communication and documentation skills. What's in it for you? We are looking for an experienced SAP SLT (SAP Landscape Transformation) Consultant to lead and support end-to-end data replication initiatives across SAP and non-SAP systems. The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience in SLT configuration, performance optimization, real-time replication, and issue resolution. This role is key to enabling data integration for major transformation programs such as SAP S/4HANA, Central Finance, and analytics platforms. Who will you report to? General Manager What qualifications will make you successful for this role? Experience in SLT for Central Finance projects (highly desirable). Interface for one or two way Communication to Other/Second/Third Party system Integration. Setting up ABAP push channel and SAP Plant connectivity as communication layer. IDOC, RFC and CIF Knowledge on Interfacing to Non-SAP system Should have good working experience on Agile methodology. Should have good working experience on DevOps Model. High level of expertise on SAP WM, HUM & MM modules Operational business experience Very good knowledge of SAP functional (processes, available functionalities, …) and technical background (customizing, environment, transport orders, …), different stages of projects (run, deployments, testing, …) as well as project management skills (planning follow-up, team work, multiple teams interaction, …) In depth understanding of SAP enterprise Structure and interface concept and management. Experience with on-site is an added advantage. Knowing basic technical ABAP debugging skills is an added advantage Behavioral Skills: Should be able to coordinate with global team and service SLA’s. | Schneider Electric | Expert - Release Architect | Bangalore | March 5, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Role: Release Architect – SAP ALM & Release Governance (ChaRM & Cloud ALM) Key Responsibilities - Release Architecture & CoE Transformation Establish enterprise release standards, policies, and governance frameworks. Transition Release Management from execution-focused to risk-based decision leadership. Own the release strategy across sprint releases, global releases, hotfixes, upgrades, and rollouts. ALM & Tooling Leadership (ChaRM & CALM) Act as subject-matter expert for: SAP ChaRM (change workflows, approvals, transport tracking, auditability). SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) (release planning, testing linkage, defect traceability, dashboards). Design end-to-end ALM workflows integrating requirements, transports, tests, and deployments. Transport Governance & Risk Management Define rules for transport sequencing, bundling, dependency handling, and post-processing. Lead impact analysis of individual transports across: Configuration, Extensibility, Roles & authorizations, Integrations & Run Serve as the final decision authority for release exceptions and deviations. Own Go/No-Go decisions and release risk sign-off. Parallel & Complex Delivery Models Architect and govern Parallel Line (e.g., Branch, Rebase, Merge). Ensure alignment between Main Line and parallel delivery streams. Define safeguards to prevent configuration drift and cross-project interference. Coordinate SAP involvement for critical release windows. Stakeholder & Executive Engagement Partner with Business, IT, Architecture, SAP, and System Integrators. Influence CAB, Release SteerCo, and Go-Live readiness forums. Translate technical release risk into business-impact language for leadership. Act as escalation point during high-risk releases and incidents. Metrics, Compliance & Continuous Improvement Define and track release KPIs (change success rate, defect leakage, MTTR, emergency changes). Ensure audit readiness and compliance across all releases. Drive continuous improvement via retrospectives and data-driven insights. Mentor and upskill Release Management team members. Required Skills & Experience SAP & ALM Expertise Deep hands-on experience with SAP ChaRM and SAP Cloud ALM. Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public and/or Private Cloud landscapes. Expert understanding of transport mechanisms and limitations across SAP environments. Experience supporting complex, high-frequency enterprise releases. Technical & Functional Awareness Strong understanding of: SAP configuration and extensibility models Authorization and business role transport behavior Integration dependencies (SAP and non-SAP) Data and master data impacts on releases Ability to assess cross-domain transport risk holistically. Leadership & Decision-Making Proven experience owning release governance and Go/No-Go decisions. Comfortable making risk-based decisions under time pressure. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to influence without direct authority. Experience Profile 8-12+ years in SAP delivery, ALM, or Release Management roles. Experience in large-scale SAP programs (multi-country, multi-ERP). Prior involvement in RM CoE setup or transformation strongly preferred. Experience working directly with SAP product teams or support is a plus. Preferred Certifications SAP S/4HANA (Public or Private Cloud) SAP Solution Manager / ChaRM SAP Cloud ALM ITIL / DevOps / Agile delivery (any) One-Line Role Summary An enterprise Release Architect responsible for designing and governing SAP release and ALM strategy, leveraging ChaRM and Cloud ALM to enable predictable, compliant, and scalable delivery through a Release Management Center of Excellence. Ideal Candidate Mindset Thinks in risk, impact, and business continuity, not just tools. Sees releases as a strategic capability, not an operational task. Ensure that tickets are properly responded to, fixed, tested and follows-up those until they are properly closed according to process defined. Support provided is functional (analysis, feed-back, recommendation …). Analyze content of releases on his/her area and recommend best organization as far as testing is concerned. Liaise with regional / local support teams and testing factory to ensure that release validation process is done properly Analyze, challenge, validate recommendations and actions of on his/her area Liaise with Global Data Excellence and Business Process Leaders organization regarding problem solving and enhancement Contribute, review and validate Core bugs & enhancements specification. Expertise in SAP PS Module and responsible for delivering the design, development, customizations, and implementation in SAP PS functionality. Experience in various areas of PS such as structuring, Planning, Costing, Assembly processing, Material procurement, MRP run, Milestone billing, result analysis and settlement Expertise in PS integration with FICO, CATS, HCM, SD. Basic knowledge on variant configuration. Good understanding of SAP enterprise Structure and interface concept and management. S4 certified and work experience needed Behavioral Skills: Should be able to coordinate with global team and service SLA’s. Ensure specifications are fully challenged and understood. Should be Good in Communication, Good learner and Very Good team Player. Ensure good application development and delivery adhering to SDLC process. Job purpose The Data Delivery Leader is responsible for overseeing the delivery of data projects and initiatives, ensuring that data solutions meet business requirements and are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. Duties and responsibilities Business analysis Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their data needs and priorities. Collaborate with data domains to understand the valid sources of data fitting to these needs Document, and translate business needs into clear data requirements Data Acquisition & Data Engineering Navigate across data domains, platforms, and system owners to acquire data Ensure Business needs are translated into production‑ready data assets. Collaborate with the Solution Architect and Cloud Architect to ensure architectural alignment and sustainability. Contribute to the design of scalable, secure, and maintainable data pipelines and connectors. Ensure data products adhere to enterprise architectural patterns and platform guardrails. Help troubleshoot data quality, lineage, and interoperability issues across sources. Project & Risk Management Manage data projects from initiation to delivery, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to quality standards. Identify and mitigate risks associated with data projects. Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders. Foster collaboration and ensure alignment with the data provisioning teams to meet delivery goals. Quality Assurance & Compliance Define data sharing agreements for the data provisions. Ensuring that data access, permissions, and use comply with governance and security.rules. Ensure data solutions meet quality standards and adhere to data maturity scoring and golden rules. He/she closely works with Product owners (AI Hub and Services Lob), experts of Data Domains, D&P, IT, Security. Work with cross-functional teams across diverse geographies. Drive excellence in the Services business.

Job Title IT Project Manager – F/M Exp 8- 10 yrs Location - Bangalore Join Schneider Electric and power your career ! Discover the opportunity to join an international, dynamic, and responsible company that fosters the development of all its people around the world. Every day, we empower employees to achieve more and experience exciting careers. Find out how our values and unique position make Schneider Electric the employer of choice. Within Schneider Digital, this role is IT project manager working for a dedicated platform. This role is responsible for leading projects using agile principles to accelerate the deployment of a platform with the objective to bring, a superior experience to our customers and Partners but also to bring a competitive advantage to our Front & Middle office with the right tools. Job Description Within the Platform Team, in relationships with the Business Transformation Leader and the Schneider Front office you are managing the process of moving the project toward completion. Your project is part of the large-scale Front Office growth and business transformation. Your mission is to be the global platform representative during the country’s deployment projects. Your responsibilities are to: •Ease and support the country deployments by promoting the use of our internal methodology (timeline, gate review, resources, …) •Explain platform features and how the process works for our countries •Animate the workshop with the country, explain the features in the reference model and identify the points where a deep dive is needed with the solution team •Make sure everyone on the team understands the project’s goals and scope. •Provide functional explanations on the master data & connectors •Ensure open points are tracked and solved, otherwise manage the appropriate escalation •Provide demo of the solution and support the country in familiarizing with the application •Drive, support the UAT sessions and be able to go into the details of the issue •Provide guidance to the country all along the digitalization journey Internal •Actively contributes to the execution of continuous improvement initiatives which help to drive adoption •Act as owner of the toolkit methodology and play an active role in its enhancement

Qualifications - Experience in software project management and testing - Experience as project manager in complex environment - Knowledge of Customer Relationship Management solutions including Salesforce.com, or equivalent. - Knowledge in SAP SD and MM Module - University or Engineering degree, preferably in Computer Science - Knowledge of agile methodologies / frameworks – Scrum, Kanban. - Knowledge of Jira & Confluence. Skills - Highly organized with the ability to multitask. - Have an IT mindset & logic: be able to understand functional issue cross platform - Ability to prioritize & escalate - Relationship building skills internally and externally. - Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional work teams toward task completion. - Self-motivated with strong organizational skills. - Good track record of obtaining results with minimal direction in a fast-paced team environment. - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. - Good interpersonal team skills for teamwork, respect, courtesy, tact, and discretion. - Analytical mindset & problem-solving aptitude. - Fluent English. | Schneider Electric | Data Risk Manager | Bangalore | March 20, 2026 | onsite | internship | junior | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Data Risk Manager – EcoStruxure Data Office At Schneider Electric, data is not just a technical asset—it is a strategic enabler of trust, scalability, and performance. Every employee, in every function, directly or indirectly uses and creates data. Data flows through every process and every role—that’s why we say: Data is everyone’s business! As a global organization, Schneider Electric generates vast amounts of data every second. To harness its full potential, we must be able to manage, govern, and deliver Trusted Data@Scale. Trusted data is the foundation that allows us to unlock new opportunities, accelerate innovation, and strengthen our position as a world‑leading Impact Company. Our Data Strategy provides a unified framework to ensure reliable data across the company. What will you do: Strategy & Governance Contextualize and operationalize the SE Data Risk strategy. Govern the Data Risk framework across the entire IoT data lifecycle. Design and implement data risk policies, controls, and mitigation frameworks. Ensure alignment with global, regional, and local data regulations. Risk Management & Compliance Anticipate, identify, prioritize, and mitigate data risks across IoT and cloud environments. Ensure compliance with data controls, regulatory requirements, and SE global standards. Lead data incident analysis, root‑cause investigation, and mitigation actions. Liaise with the Data Risk & Security teams for audits, assurance, and risk governance. Program & Process Oversight Monitor overall progress of Data Risk initiatives across Ecostruxure Platform Program‑manage the implementation of risk mitigation and data controls within the Data Office. Ensure data‑related processes, systems, and assets are secure and protected from internal and external threats. In Brief Maintain the EcoStruxure Data Risk Framework (Discovery → Classification → Flow Mapping → Risk Assessment → Controls → Monitoring → Incident Response). Maintain the IoT Data Risk Register and provide risk scoring and prioritization. Drive data security initiatives DSPM (Data Security Posture Management) and DLP (Data Loss Prevention). Support risk‑by‑design in product and platform development lifecycles leveraging security advisors Map IoT and cloud data flows and identify high‑risk paths requiring enhanced controls. Ensure compliance with GDPR, NIS2, CRA, AI Act, Data Act, CCPA, LGPD, and customer contractual requirements. What will make you successful: Strong experience in data governance, cybersecurity, cloud security, and IoT ecosystems. Strong understanding of Azure cloud, data pipelines, microservices, and API‑based architectures. Knowledge of global data regulations and privacy frameworks. Familiarity with DSPM, DLP, encryption models, access governance, and secure‑by‑design. Excellent communication skills, autonomy, analytical thinking, and cross‑functional leadership. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Governance, or related field. Certifications (nice to have): CIPP/E, CIPM, ISO 27001, CRISC, CCSK, AZ‑500. Data Risk Manager – EcoStruxure Data Office At Schneider Electric, data is not just a technical asset—it is a strategic enabler of trust, scalability, and performance. Every employee, in every function, directly or indirectly uses and creates data. Data flows through every process and every role—that’s why we say: Data is everyone’s business! As a global organization, Schneider Electric generates vast amounts of data every second. To harness its full potential, we must be able to manage, govern, and deliver Trusted Data@Scale. Trusted data is the foundation that allows us to unlock new opportunities, accelerate innovation, and strengthen our position as a world‑leading Impact Company. Our Data Strategy provides a unified framework to ensure reliable data across the company. What will you do: Strategy & Governance Contextualize and operationalize the SE Data Risk strategy. Govern the Data Risk framework across the entire IoT data lifecycle. Design and implement data risk policies, controls, and mitigation frameworks. Ensure alignment with global, regional, and local data regulations. Risk Management & Compliance Anticipate, identify, prioritize, and mitigate data risks across IoT and cloud environments. Ensure compliance with data controls, regulatory requirements, and SE global standards. Lead data incident analysis, root‑cause investigation, and mitigation actions. Liaise with the Data Risk & Security teams for audits, assurance, and risk governance. Program & Process Oversight Monitor overall progress of Data Risk initiatives across Ecostruxure Platform Program‑manage the implementation of risk mitigation and data controls within the Data Office. Ensure data‑related processes, systems, and assets are secure and protected from internal and external threats. In Brief Maintain the EcoStruxure Data Risk Framework (Discovery → Classification → Flow Mapping → Risk Assessment → Controls → Monitoring → Incident Response). Maintain the IoT Data Risk Register and provide risk scoring and prioritization. Drive data security initiatives DSPM (Data Security Posture Management) and DLP (Data Loss Prevention). Support risk‑by‑design in product and platform development lifecycles leveraging security advisors Map IoT and cloud data flows and identify high‑risk paths requiring enhanced controls. Ensure compliance with GDPR, NIS2, CRA, AI Act, Data Act, CCPA, LGPD, and customer contractual requirements. What will make you successful: Strong experience in data governance, cybersecurity, cloud security, and IoT ecosystems. Strong understanding of Azure cloud, data pipelines, microservices, and API‑based architectures. Knowledge of global data regulations and privacy frameworks. Familiarity with DSPM, DLP, encryption models, access governance, and secure‑by‑design. Excellent communication skills, autonomy, analytical thinking, and cross‑functional leadership. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Governance, or related field. Certifications (nice to have): CIPP/E, CIPM, ISO 27001, CRISC, CCSK, AZ‑500.

| Schneider Electric | Principal, Services Business Analyst | Bangalore | March 25, 2026 | onsite | contract | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Principal, Services Business Analyst Exp 10 -12 yrs Location Bangalore Job Purpose The Salesforce Business Analyst acts as the key link between business stakeholders and digital delivery teams, translating business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions. The role focuses on requirement definition, solution design support, backlog grooming, testing, and adoption—ensuring Salesforce (and related platforms such as ServiceMax, CPQ, and ERP integrations) effectively support end-to-end business processes. This role is critical in large-scale transformation programs, continuous improvement releases, and global rollouts across Services Key Responsibilities Business Analysis & Requirements Management Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements across Salesforce-based processes (Sales, Services, Contracts, Installed Base, Case Management). Translate business needs into user stories, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria. Ensure requirements are clearly understood by delivery teams and aligned with global templates and reference models. Maintain traceability between business requirements and delivered functionality. Solution Design & Functional Expertise Act as the functional expert for Salesforce and adjacent platforms (ServiceMax, CPQ, integrations with ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle). Collaborate with Architects and Solution Leads to define end-to-end solution designs. Validate solution options against business needs, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Contribute to design reviews and ensure adherence to Salesforce and enterprise best practices. Backlog Management & Agile Delivery Work closely with Product Owners to groom and prioritize the Salesforce backlog. Support sprint planning by clarifying scope, dependencies, and functional details. Participate actively in agile ceremonies (refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives). Ensure delivered features meet acceptance criteria and business expectations. Stakeholder Management & Communication Serve as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders on Salesforce topics. Facilitate workshops, deep dives, and solution walkthroughs. Communicate clearly on scope, impacts, risks, and dependencies. Support change management and user adoption through training materials and documentation. Requirements Functional & Technical Skills Strong experience as a Business Analyst in Salesforce environments. Solid understanding of Salesforce core clouds (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud) and data model. Experience with integrations between Salesforce and ERP / CPQ / Field Service platforms. Familiarity with Agile / Scrum delivery models and tools (JIRA, Confluence). Business & Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to simplify complex topics and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. Proven stakeholder management in global, cross-functional environments. Structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused mindset. Qualification Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or related field. 8+ years of experience in Business Analysis roles, with significant Salesforce exposure. | Schneider Electric | Principal, E2E Solution Business Analyst | Bangalore | March 31, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Principal, E2E Solution Business Analyst Job Purpose Services Business at Schneider Electric is a 3 B€+ business with strong growth ambitions. To enable this acceleration, Services Business is performing a Global transformation of its operating model, processes and digital capabilities (Offer, Pricing, Quotation, Service Execution) In this context, the Principal, E2E Solution Business Analyst plays a key role to ensure the alignment of the Digital Solution which is delivered on the field and what is being built / developed in terms of platforms & interfaces. As such, it will ensure countries can converge towards the target E2E Solution and that are Services Business is digitally ready for:  Meeting Services growth ambitions  Services offers launch, including hero offers (e.g. EcoCare)  UNIFY deployment (J2R / Journey-to-Readiness)  … Key Responsibilities The Principal, E2E Solution Business Analyst is ensuring the convergence of country IT landscape towards target E2E solution, also ensuring the feedback loop from countries towards capabilities / platforms / interfaces, in close relationship with the E2E Solution Design Manager. Services Transformation Program portfolio is expected to accelerate to more than 50+ active projects per year – typically 10 to 20 per geography – requiring a high level of anticipation, coordination and preparation. Scope of the Transformation: Offer, Pricing, Quotation, Execution a. Support country deployments – E2E Solution expertise role  In close relationship with the Deployment Leader – Digital (also reporting to Services Digital Transformation Program Director), support as-is assessment / gap analysis – between the current country IT/process landscape and the target one, and identify / work on gap resolution actions.  Propose functional / technical alternatives in terms of E2E Solution, to manage country requests yet limit overall solution complexity / enhancements.  Support Digital troubleshooting to identify root cause and support issue resolution pathway (if needed, leverage Digital Capabilities / DTC teams) b. Be the bridge between country requests and digital build – E2E Solution coordination role  Funnel enhancement requests to Line of Business / Digital capabilities, in collaboration with E2E Solution Design manager  Provide feedback loop to country projects on enhancements delivery (what / when), linked to country requests c. Contribute to digital build roadmap & governance – E2E Solution Build support role  Participate to E2E Solution Build governance (involving Digital Capabilities, E2E Solution Design, Delivery teams, …) – under definition.  Participate to E2E Solution roadmap review and follow-up. Requirements Qualifications:  Business or Engineering Degree.  10+ years in Digital delivery and/or Program/Project Management.  Strong foundations on ERP technologies (SAP & Oracle) and integration frameworks.  Knowledge of CPQ and Service Execution platforms (esp Oracle, Salesforce).  Business Analyst experience preferred.  Proven successful experience and track record in large scale business / digital transformation.  Strong interpersonal skills, with ability to communicate and convince at various levels of the organization, and in a multicultural environment.  Knowledge of Services Business and/or Digital Customer Relationship and/or UNIFY transformations is a strong plus Skills:  Strategic vision & storytelling,  Take risks and innovate,  Strong analytical and synthesis skills,  Initiative to uncover and solve problems proactively,  Strong stakeholder management,  Focus on customers,  Fluent in English. | Schneider Electric | Release Engineer | Bangalore | March 10, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Role Overview We are looking for Release Engineers to join our SAP Release Management team, responsible for end-toend release execution, quality deployment, and production readiness across SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud and Public Cloud landscapes. The role focuses on safe, compliant, and predictable deployments, release governance, and stakeholder coordination across global teams. Key Responsibilities • Plan and execute release deployments across SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud, Public Cloud and associated SAP systems, from quality to production. • Own quality and production deployment runbooks, including pre checks, import sequencing, post processing, smoke checks, and handover to operations. • Organize and facilitate CAB (Change Advisory Board) / Release Board meetings, ensuring scope, risks, DNQ/DNP and rollback plans are clearly presented and approved. • Manage DNQ / DNP tracking and communication, ensuring rejected changes are documented, re planned and do not reach production by mistake. • Maintain the release calendar (monthly sprints, emergency releases, dedicated authorization windows), ensuring alignment with blackout periods and major business events. • Coordinate transport movement throughout the landscapes (Dev → Test → Pre Prod → Prod), ensuring correct sequencing, dependency handling and minimal production impact. • Monitor transport imports and return codes (e.g., via STMS), perform initial analysis and coordinate with Basis / development teams to resolve failures. • Ensure audit and compliance requirements are met change records, approvals, test evidence, SoD checks for authorization transports, and complete deployment documentation. • Support and help optimize usage of SAP Solution Manager ChaRM and/or SAP Cloud ALM for change, deployment and release management (linking requirements, work items and transports). • Collaborate with project and run teams to prepare release scope, validate readiness (testing, data, cutover tasks), and support cutover activities and hypercare. • Contribute to continuous improvement of release processes, templates and dashboards (e.g., KPIs on release success rate, incident after release, lead time). Technical Competencies • Strong understanding of SAP system landscapes (ECC / S/4HANA, Private & Public Cloud). • Hands on experience with SAP transport management and deployments, ideally including Solution Manager ChaRM and/or SAP Cloud ALM for change and deployment. • Working knowledge of STMS, transport return codes, and dependency handling. General • Solid understanding of SDLC, ITIL, and Release Management processes. • Experience working with ServiceNow / ITSM tools. • Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint for reporting and audit documentation. Good-to-Have Skills • Exposure to SAP Cloud (RISE / Public Cloud) release models. • Experience with Azure DevOps / Jira for release tracking. • Familiarity with cutover management and hypercare models. • Prior experience in global, multi-time-zone SAP programs. Behavioral Competencies • Strong ownership and accountability for release outcomes. • Ability to work under pressure in time-bound, production-critical situations. • Clear and confident communication with technical and business stakeholders. • Structured, detail-oriented, and compliance-focused mindset. • Team player with the ability to balance speed and quality. Education & Experience • Bachelor’s degree (Engineering / Science / Commerce or equivalent). • 3–6 years of experience in SAP Release / Change / Deployment Management. What Success Looks Like • Predictable, high-quality SAP releases with minimal production incidents. • Strong release governance and audit readiness. • Trusted release partner for business, SAP, and platform leadership. This role requires a strong background in project management, a solid understanding of CAD tools, and hands-on experience with PLM solutions such as Siemens Teamcenter, PTC Windchill, Dassault ENOVIA, or Autodesk Fusion Lifecycle. Manage integration between PLM systems and CAD platforms (e.g., NX, Creo, SolidWorks, CATIA). Facilitate migration of legacy data and ensure accurate configuration of PLM environments. Develop detailed project plans, manage budgets, allocate resources, and track progress. Oversee system testing, validation, training, and user adoption strategies. Coordinate with software vendors and third-party service providers. Identify and mitigate project risks and issues to ensure successful delivery. Support change management and ensure alignment with overall business processes and digital transformation goals. What will make you successful: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical or related field. 15+ years of project management experience, with a focus on PLM system implementation and integration. Solid understanding of CAD tools and how they integrate with PLM systems. Experience with at least one major PLM platform (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter, Windchill, ENOVIA). Strong knowledge of the software product lifecycle, from market research to launch and iteration. Deep understanding of modern software technologies, cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), and frameworks. Proficient in Agile/SAFe methodologies, with experience using tools like Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps. Familiarity with business processes across product development, manufacturing, and supply chain. Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Smartsheet). PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certification is a plus. Qualification: Experience working in a manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, or consumer products industry. Exposure to ERP and MES systems integration. Knowledge of systems architecture, APIs, or middleware for enterprise integration. Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and modern product architectures (e.g., microservices, APIs). Understanding of data privacy, global compliance standards, and multi-region deployment considerations. Strong background on Cyber Security compliances is mandatory Knowledge on SaaS product development is an added advantage Ability to lead cross-functional and international teams. | Schneider Electric | SAP LE Senior Consultant | Bangalore | December 19, 2025 | onsite | contract | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Job Descriptions Job Title: SAP LE Senior Consultant Experience: 6-10 years Location: Bengaluru, India Qualifications - BE/ B Tech./MCA/ Graduate Responsibilities What will you do? In depth understanding of Logistics Execution Process, in both ECC & S4 HANA. Develop system designs that adhere to high level conceptual design and are traceable to functional as well as non-functional requirements in projects/enhancements Ensure designs produced adhere to architectural roadmap and support the development, execution, and operations of solutions Experience in Application Support and working on SLA, CHR Delivery process to meet customer requirements and Any SAP Project Implementation activities. Deliver design solutions in line with system design standards which are global and scalable following a global template philosophy (Core/Template) Ensure that solutions meet requirements outlined in the architecture handbook Perform scoping, fit-gap workshops for projects/enhancements, proposes solutions for key gaps, provide effort estimations and align with business teams Ensure that project/enhancements work is delivered to agreed time, cost and quality constraints following the release calendars Ensure that developed solutions are peer reviewed, formally documented and signed off by business Initiate solution testing to ensure these meet quality standards Follow standardized design and development processes to enable cost effective delivery Proficient and well versed in working in S4 HANA system for SE UNIFY Journey - Analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP S/4HANA functional specifications across relevant modules (e.g., MM, SD, PP, FI/CO, QM, PM). Configure and customize SAP S/4HANA modules to align with business processes and UNIFY standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration between modules and third-party systems. Conduct unit testing, integration testing, and support user acceptance testing (UAT). Provide end-user training and create functional documentation and SOPs. What skills and capabilities will make you successful? 6 to 10 years of experience as consultant with complex and multi-ERP landscape (both complete Core template design / build / validation, roll-out and support) in the area of SAP – LE (Logistics Execution) and SD modules with hands-on experience on the following areas Intercompany Sales - SO / PO Scenario, Cross company STO and Intercompany Billing Transportation – Shipments, Freight cost pricing and settlement Shipping - Packing, Loading and Post good issue Foreign trade and Customs Availability check and scheduling IDOCS/EDI Understanding of user exits and debugging skills Functional competencies High level of expertise in SAP Logistics Execution and integration areas Understanding on Sales Process, Contract management, Pricing concepts, OTC, Partner Determination, Text Management, Pricing, Taxes, Billing, Credit Management, Back Orders, and Master Data Management (MDM). Involved in configuring Master Data, Document Types (Sales Order Types, Delivery Documents, Billing Documents, Credit and debit memo, etc.) including special order types (Third Party Processing, Consignment Processing, Inter-Company Billing and Inter-company stock transfers), Availability Check, Material Listing/Exclusion, Rebate processing, Deliveries and Post Goods Issues Good understanding of SAP enterprise Structure and interface concept and management. S4 HANA work experience is needed Behavioral Skills: Should be able to coordinate with global team and service SLA’s. Excellent communication skills both verbal and written with the ability to tailor communication to the intended audience (excellent English is a must) Team player and networking (colleagues as well as external partners) Capacity to challenge partners as well as capacity to show added value in relationship with them Ensure specifications are fully challenged and understood. Ensure good application development and delivery adhering to SDLC process. Customer centric and capacity to deliver high level of service. What's in it for you? Be a Digital Transformation Champion: This is your chance to be at the heart of our S/4HANA journey. Working within a dynamic team, you will drive the successful deployment of standardized, future-state S/4HANA processes, critically redefining how our business operates. You will take the lead in ensuring the effective adoption of SAP Best Practices, guaranteeing process consistency across global units, and building the foundational, clean-core system that supports our long-term growth. | Schneider Electric | Expert, bFS E2E & ERP specialist | Bangalore | March 31, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Job title - Services bFS E2E & ERP specialist Job Purpose Services Business at Schneider Electric is a 3 B€+ business with strong growth ambitions. To enable this acceleration, Services Business is performing a Global transformation of its operating model, processes and digital capabilities. The bFS E2E & ERP specialist ensures that digital platforms operate as one coherent ecosystem by proactively tracking and resolving issues that arise in the communication between systems, while acting as a key liaison between platform owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to maintain smooth, reliable, and fully aligned end‑to‑end processes. More specifically, bFS is the Field Service Management platform built on Salesforce platform (ServiceMax). Key Responsibilities Within the Services capability of the Schneider Digital / End to End Customer Relationship practice, you will be responsible to deploy the required digital enablers related to bFS program for services, fully integrated in an End-to-End manner. As such, you will coordinate with all digital streams required to make the bFS deployment project a success, across various countries and business units such as Power, Industry, Secure Power, and Digital Energy Services businesses. More specifically your responsibilities are to: • Lead the bFS E2E integration, in close collaboration with all the stakeholders. • Ensure the business requirements are well captured and considered. • Assemble supervise the design, build and test of the solution, across the different platforms to deliver the bFS E2E functionalities (bFO, CPQ, SAP ERP, bFS, etc). • Act as a key integrator with strong end-to-end process knowledge of service journeys, service flows, and cross-platform interactions. • Capture, challenge, and consolidate business requirements, ensuring they are fully considered and translated into integrated digital solutions. • Lead and coordinate gap analysis activities, identifying integration (and when applicable functional and process) gaps across systems and service flows. • Drive gap resolution in collaboration with business, IT, and digital stream owners, ensuring alignment with target end-to-end solutions. Requirements Qualifications / Experience: • Bachelor/Master of Engineering degree • In-depth knowledge of the Services business • Previous experience of working with ERPs (SAP R3) and integration • Knowledge to Salesforce platform (fka Force.com) is a must. Knowledge of Servicemax is a strong plus. • Knowledge of CPQ (Oracle CPQ) is preferred • Experience in working with multi-technology integrated systems and ability to manage integration and communication between systems and teams. • Proven successful experience and track record in large scale business transformation, as well as global program and project management. • Work experience with global stake holders to plan project phases and deployment timelines with technical and business teams. • Work as an interface between business and various teams from different technologies for issue resolution and continuous improvement. Skills:  Fluent English  Strong analytical and synthesis skills  Initiative to uncover and solve problems proactively.  Tech-savvy professionals, with a deep knowledge of how technology works to achieve business goals.  Strong interpersonal skills, with ability to communicate and convince at various levels of the organization, and in a multicultural environment. Maintain documentation of DRC configurations, interfaces, and exception handling scenarios in line with IT compliance policies. Engage in proactive collaboration with SAP Product Support and external partners for issue resolution, legal updates, and roadmap alignment. What skills and capabilities will make you successful? Proficient in data mapping, XML/UBL formats, API management, and outbound e-document frameworks. Familiarity with SAP BTP, AIF, and IDoc/EDI processing in a cloud context. Experience implementing DRC as part of global rollout projects in large enterprise environments. Understanding of European legal requirements for e-invoicing, digital signatures, and real-time reporting. What's in it for you? | Schneider Electric | Service Desk Analyst | Bangalore | March 13, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Job Description: The Service Desk Analyst provides support for basic incident resolution and requests reported by APAC Schneider Employees. Responsibilities include initial assessment, research, and resolution of basic incidents and requests regarding use of applications, software and infrastructure components. The Service Desk Analyst would be responsible for collecting information through a customer conversation, probing, accessing support tools, and additional support teams if needed. Problems beyond the scope of their ability or responsibility are resolved by engaging other support teams in a timely manner. Logs and tracks incidents/requests from identification through resolution. Follows up with other support teams involved in resolution to ensure incidents are resolved, requests are filled, and the customer communication is complete. Documents resolutions and updates self-help knowledgebase. 6) Gains knowledge on applications, processes, and support to increase ability to resolve requests on first contact. 7) Provides after hours and on-call support as needed. 8) Adheres to and supports ITIL standards and procedures. 9) Adheres to Companies Code of Conduct and Mission and Value statements. 10) Flexible to perform other adhoc duties/shifts assigned as per operational requirement. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (Required): Demonstrates and desire to learn processes, application, and technology. Demonstrates good customer handling skills and techniques. ITIL Foundation certification (not Mandatory) Prior experience in supporting customers in Technical Service Desk environment. Prior experience voice, chat & email support. Integrate CPQ with RPA solutions to deliver seamless end-to-end processes. Analyse business processes and identify automation opportunities. | Schneider Electric | Lead, SAP MBC Analyst | Bangalore | December 11, 2025 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | What will you do? An SAP S/4 Multi-Bank Connector (MBC) Senior Consultant is responsible for implementing and managing SAP’s Multi-Bank Connectivity solution, which enables secure and automated communication between SAP systems and multiple banking partners. This role focuses on treasury operations, payment processing, and bank integration within SAP S/4HANA. Implementation & Configuration: Design and configure SAP Multi-Bank Connector for secure bank communication. Set up payment formats (ISO 20022, SWIFT) and connectivity protocols. Integration: Integrate MBC with SAP S/4HANA Treasury and Cash Management modules. Ensure seamless connectivity with multiple banks globally. Compliance & Security: Implement security measures for payment transactions and bank data. Ensure compliance with global payment standards and regulations. Monitoring & Support: Monitor payment flows and troubleshoot connectivity issues. Provide ongoing support for system upgrades and enhancements. Collaboration: Work with treasury, finance, and IT teams to optimize payment processes. What skills and capabilities will make you successful? Strong knowledge of SAP Multi-Bank Connector and SAP S/4HANA Treasury. Experience with bank integration, payment formats, and SWIFT/ISO standards. Familiarity with SAP Cloud Platform and APIs for bank connectivity. Understanding of global payment regulations and treasury operations. Analytical and problem-solving skills. What's in it for you? Knowledge of multi-currency payment processing and global banking networks. which enables secure and automated communication between SAP systems and multiple banking partners. This role focuses on treasury operations, payment processing, and bank integration within SAP S/4HANA. Who will you report to? | Schneider Electric | Application Analyst | Bangalore | March 27, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Role Overview We are looking for Release Engineers to join our SAP Release Management team, responsible for end-toend release execution, quality deployment, and production readiness across SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud and Public Cloud landscapes. The role focuses on safe, compliant, and predictable deployments, release governance, and stakeholder coordination across global teams. Key Responsibilities • Plan and execute release deployments across SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud, Public Cloud and associated SAP systems, from quality to production. • Own quality and production deployment runbooks, including pre checks, import sequencing, post processing, smoke checks, and handover to operations. • Organize and facilitate CAB (Change Advisory Board) / Release Board meetings, ensuring scope, risks, DNQ/DNP and rollback plans are clearly presented and approved. • Manage DNQ / DNP tracking and communication, ensuring rejected changes are documented, re planned and do not reach production by mistake. • Maintain the release calendar (monthly sprints, emergency releases, dedicated authorization windows), ensuring alignment with blackout periods and major business events. • Coordinate transport movement throughout the landscapes (Dev → Test → Pre Prod → Prod), ensuring correct sequencing, dependency handling and minimal production impact. • Monitor transport imports and return codes (e.g., via STMS), perform initial analysis and coordinate with Basis / development teams to resolve failures. • Ensure audit and compliance requirements are met change records, approvals, test evidence, SoD checks for authorization transports, and complete deployment documentation. • Support and help optimize usage of SAP Solution Manager ChaRM and/or SAP Cloud ALM for change, deployment and release management (linking requirements, work items and transports). • Collaborate with project and run teams to prepare release scope, validate readiness (testing, data, cutover tasks), and support cutover activities and hypercare. • Contribute to continuous improvement of release processes, templates and dashboards (e.g., KPIs on release success rate, incident after release, lead time). Technical Competencies • Strong understanding of SAP system landscapes (ECC / S/4HANA, Private & Public Cloud). • Hands on experience with SAP transport management and deployments, ideally including Solution Manager ChaRM and/or SAP Cloud ALM for change and deployment. • Working knowledge of STMS, transport return codes, and dependency handling. General • Solid understanding of SDLC, ITIL, and Release Management processes. • Experience working with ServiceNow / ITSM tools. • Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint for reporting and audit documentation. Good-to-Have Skills • Exposure to SAP Cloud (RISE / Public Cloud) release models. • Experience with Azure DevOps / Jira for release tracking. • Familiarity with cutover management and hypercare models. • Prior experience in global, multi-time-zone SAP programs. Behavioral Competencies • Strong ownership and accountability for release outcomes. • Ability to work under pressure in time-bound, production-critical situations. • Clear and confident communication with technical and business stakeholders. • Structured, detail-oriented, and compliance-focused mindset. • Team player with the ability to balance speed and quality. Education & Experience • Bachelor’s degree (Engineering / Science / Commerce or equivalent). • 3–6 years of experience in SAP Release / Change / Deployment Management. What Success Looks Like • Predictable, high-quality SAP releases with minimal production incidents. • Strong release governance and audit readiness. • Trusted release partner for business, SAP, and platform leadership. Master Azure AI Services (Azure ML Services, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI) or AWS AI Services (AWS SageMaker, Bedrock). Good general knowledge of at least one of the following cloud service providers stacks : Azure or AWS. Knowledge of LangChain products (LangChain, LangSmith, LangGraph) is a plus. | Schneider Electric | Application Analyst | Bangalore | March 25, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Role Overview We are looking for Release Engineers to join our SAP Release Management team, responsible for end-toend release execution, quality deployment, and production readiness across SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud and Public Cloud landscapes. The role focuses on safe, compliant, and predictable deployments, release governance, and stakeholder coordination across global teams. Key Responsibilities • Plan and execute release deployments across SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud, Public Cloud and associated SAP systems, from quality to production. • Own quality and production deployment runbooks, including pre checks, import sequencing, post processing, smoke checks, and handover to operations. • Organize and facilitate CAB (Change Advisory Board) / Release Board meetings, ensuring scope, risks, DNQ/DNP and rollback plans are clearly presented and approved. • Manage DNQ / DNP tracking and communication, ensuring rejected changes are documented, re planned and do not reach production by mistake. • Maintain the release calendar (monthly sprints, emergency releases, dedicated authorization windows), ensuring alignment with blackout periods and major business events. • Coordinate transport movement throughout the landscapes (Dev → Test → Pre Prod → Prod), ensuring correct sequencing, dependency handling and minimal production impact. • Monitor transport imports and return codes (e.g., via STMS), perform initial analysis and coordinate with Basis / development teams to resolve failures. • Ensure audit and compliance requirements are met change records, approvals, test evidence, SoD checks for authorization transports, and complete deployment documentation. • Support and help optimize usage of SAP Solution Manager ChaRM and/or SAP Cloud ALM for change, deployment and release management (linking requirements, work items and transports). • Collaborate with project and run teams to prepare release scope, validate readiness (testing, data, cutover tasks), and support cutover activities and hypercare. • Contribute to continuous improvement of release processes, templates and dashboards (e.g., KPIs on release success rate, incident after release, lead time). Technical Competencies • Strong understanding of SAP system landscapes (ECC / S/4HANA, Private & Public Cloud). • Hands on experience with SAP transport management and deployments, ideally including Solution Manager ChaRM and/or SAP Cloud ALM for change and deployment. • Working knowledge of STMS, transport return codes, and dependency handling. General • Solid understanding of SDLC, ITIL, and Release Management processes. • Experience working with ServiceNow / ITSM tools. • Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint for reporting and audit documentation. Good-to-Have Skills • Exposure to SAP Cloud (RISE / Public Cloud) release models. • Experience with Azure DevOps / Jira for release tracking. • Familiarity with cutover management and hypercare models. • Prior experience in global, multi-time-zone SAP programs. Behavioral Competencies • Strong ownership and accountability for release outcomes. • Ability to work under pressure in time-bound, production-critical situations. • Clear and confident communication with technical and business stakeholders. • Structured, detail-oriented, and compliance-focused mindset. • Team player with the ability to balance speed and quality. Education & Experience • Bachelor’s degree (Engineering / Science / Commerce or equivalent). • 3–6 years of experience in SAP Release / Change / Deployment Management. What Success Looks Like • Predictable, high-quality SAP releases with minimal production incidents. • Strong release governance and audit readiness. • Trusted release partner for business, SAP, and platform leadership. SAP Data Services: In-depth knowledge of SAP Data Services, including both administration and development aspects. Problem-Solving: Ability to understand job flows in Data Services, identify underlying issues, and implement fixes. SAP Finance & Controlling: Basic understanding of SAP Finance and Controlling modules. Data Migration: Proven experience in data migration projects, with a solid grasp of data migration principles. Syniti Expertise: Expertise in Syniti Data Integration, including constructs and utilization of stored procedures to manage data flow. Integration of SQL with Syniti. SAP Data Services: In-depth knowledge of SAP Data Services, including both administration and development aspects. Problem-Solving: Ability to understand job flows in Data Services, identify underlying issues, and implement fixes. SAP Finance & Controlling: Basic understanding of SAP Finance and Controlling modules. Data Migration: Proven experience in data migration projects, with a solid grasp of data migration principles. Syniti Expertise: Expertise in Syniti Data Integration, including constructs and utilization of stored procedures to manage data flow. Integration of SQL with Syniti. Key Experience: - Total 8 to 11 years of SAP BASIS, SAP HANA and S/4 HANA experience including 4 years in BTP and Data sphere Administration is an added advantage. – Deep experience with SAP HANA architecture and technical concepts. - Knowledge of S/4HANA, Suite on HANA and HANA database as a foundation including the usages/implementation of Fiori Apps and HANA Live. Mastery of the HANA knowledge including High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Backup/Recovery, Security related to HANA platform. SAP RISE/GROW :- Applicants should possess hands-on experience with SAP RISE and SAP GROW platforms to be considered for this role. Organize Day-to-day operation (Administration/Monitoring tasks) of the S/4HANA, SAP HANA and ECC environments. - Ensure Security on SAP S/4 HANA. Technical Skills: - Deep knowledge of SAP HANA in-Memory Platform core technology, including architecture, landscape design, installation, upgrades, performance tuning, and system integration. - Hands on experience of implementation and conversion for S/4HANA solutions. – Deep knowledge of SAP Basis: Technical Planning, Installations and Configurations (SAP S/4 HANA…), Upgrades, OS/ DB Migrations, Unicode Conversions for SAP NetWeaver platform, SSO configuration, install SSL certificates, Familiar with BRTOOLS for Space management and SLT Installation & Configuration. – Applying Support Package, Kernel patch upgrade, TMS configuration and Transport administration, General administration, Maintaining of Operation Modes and Profile Parameters, Background Job Management and customer raised tickets using BPC tool and ISM tool. – Experience in User Management. - Experience in SAP Backup and Recovery. - Hardware, operating systems and networking connectivity required for the SAP environment. - Elaboration of SAP release plan. - Transport strategy. - Experience in Refreshes tasks, Client copies (local client copy, client export, client import). – SAP testing automation tools and strategies. - Monitoring: systems Logs, Work processes overview, Lock entries, Updates, background jobs, system health check… - Incident Management: Troubleshooting the issues from OS level like work process monitoring, checking logs, checking OSS notes, provide Performance analysis and suggest solution to write the Root Cause Analysis. - Performance optimization and tuning: BTP experience & skills: At least the last 4 years involved in the administration and operations of SAP BTP platforms. Accounts, Subaccounts & Directories configuration, and operations. Service subscriptions, service instances and service keys management. SAP BTP Security: Connectivity, authentication, authorization, SSO & Principal Propagation configuration and operations (SAP Cloud Identity Services). BTP Hana Cloud DB & Datasphere configuration, and operations. BTP CTMS & CI/CD configuration, and operations. What skills and capabilities will make you successful? BTP experience & skills: At least the last 4 years involved in the administration and operations of SAP BTP platforms. Accounts, Subaccounts & Directories configuration, and operations. Service subscriptions, service instances and service keys management. SAP BTP Security: Connectivity, authentication, authorization, SSO & Principal Propagation configuration and operations (SAP Cloud Identity Services). BTP Hana Cloud DB & Datasphere configuration, and operations. BTP CTMS & CI/CD configuration, and operations. Deep knowledge of SAP Basis: Technical Planning, Installations and Configurations (SAP S/4 HANA…), Upgrades, OS/ DB Migrations, Unicode Conversions for SAP NetWeaver platform, SSO configuration, install SSL certificates, Familiar with BRTOOLS for Space management and SLT Installation & Configuration. Deep experience with SAP HANA architecture and technical concepts. - Knowledge of S/4HANA, Suite on HANA and HANA database as a foundation including the usages/implementation of Fiori Apps and HANA Live. Mastery of the HANA knowledge including High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Backup/Recovery, Security related to HANA platform. SAP testing automation tools and strategies What's in it for you? Career Growth as a Senior technical Architect on BTP/S4 Hana. Who will you report to? He/She will be a Single Contributor and will be part of Global ERP Infrastructure Team. And reporting to Technical General Manager, GTS Stream. Qualifications Preferred Qualification: - Expert level (Level 3) experience in SAP is mandatory. - Technical certification: Azure or AWS or S4 Hana. Any experience with SAP on Cloud is highly desirable. - Certification in SAP S/4 HANA and OS/DB Migration. - SAP BASIS/NetWeaver certification a plus. - SAP Fiori knowledge is highly desirable. An Engineering degree with relevant experience is preferred. | Schneider Electric | Digital Sustainability Subject Matter Expert | Bangalore | February 18, 2026 | hybrid | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Job Title: Digital Sustainability Subject Matter Expert (SME) Job Overview The Digital Sustainability SME is a hybrid expert in sustainability and digital transformation, responsible for shaping Schneider Electric’s digital sustainability strategy in alignment with the Corporate Sustainability roadmap and long-term ambitions. This role bridges technical sustainability frameworks and cutting-edge digital solutions—guiding the selection, adoption, and integration of best-in-class platforms, software, and tools to enable credible, scalable, and auditable sustainability outcomes. The SME partners with business, IT, and sustainability leaders to anticipate industry trends and steer strategic decisions on technology requirements, solution design, and future-proofing sustainability processes. What's in it for you Shape and drive the digital sustainability strategy, aligning digital roadmaps with corporate sustainability goals and regulatory frameworks (GHG Protocol, CSRD/ESRS, IFRS S1/S2, GRI, SBTi). Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of digital platforms, data solutions, and software tools supporting core sustainability processes (carbon accounting, supplier engagement, lifecycle analysis, reporting, and decarbonization). Serve as the primary interface between business sustainability teams and IT/digital functions to translate sustainability requirements into actionable technology solutions and recommendations. What will make you successful: 10+ years in IT, digital transformation, or sustainability technology, with 4+ years in sustainability, ESG, or decarbonization roles. Demonstrated experience implementing digital platforms or software supporting sustainability and ESG. Experience in industrial, manufacturing, or global organizations is preferred. Professional certifications in sustainability, digital transformation, or enterprise technology are a plus. What will you do: Drive continuous improvement in digital workflows and end-user experience for sustainability data management and analytics. Collaborate cross-functionally with procurement, operations, finance, and external partners to embed sustainability and digital thinking into business-as-usual. Ensure audit readiness, data security, and compliance through robust digital governance and controls. Champion a culture of digital innovation and sustainability, coaching team members and stakeholders on new tools and trends. What will make you successful: Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital best practices, proactively advising on opportunities to strengthen the sustainability technology stack. Define sustainability data architecture, integration, validation, and quality checkpoints across systems and platforms. Support Scope 1–3 measurement methodologies, supplier and product-level data capture, and automation of reporting processes What's in it for you: Opportunity to shape and drive technological innovation in a dynamic environment Lead strategic initiatives that directly impact organizational success Collaborative culture that values creative problem-solving and continuous learning Professional growth through exposure to cutting-edge technologies and methodologies Chance to mentor and influence best practices across development teams Qualifications Strong knowledge of sustainability standards and digital solutions (GHG Protocol, ESG frameworks, LCA/PCF, data platforms, analytics tools). Hands-on experience with digital sustainability platforms (e.g., carbon management software, ESG data platforms, workflow automation, analytics/BI tools). Proven ability to design, implement, or optimize digital workflows for sustainability data, reporting, and analytics. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to distil complex requirements into practical digital solutions. Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills; able to influence across business, IT, and sustainability domains. Let us learn about you! Apply today. This position requires the candidate to be an expert in ServiceNow design and development principles that enables them to work with external development partners and key stakeholders, following best practices. The candidate will join an existing team, working to support a global enterprise application delivering quality solutions. They will help define platform governance, architecture, and will drive innovation in the field of analytics, business intelligence, & self-service. Responsibilities: Defines policy & standards – Architecture principles, Integration standards, Release management, Platform upgrade strategy, performance tuning etc. Key member of innovation and governance team; focusing on development of complex projects Help with critical technical architecture documentation for existing implementations, build framework structure/templates for capturing technical information on future implementations, project work Enforces architecture governance structures, methodologies (architecture and engineering), and compliance activities to maintain regulatory compliance and enterprise standards Define development best practices, architecture, & code/model review check list Provide technical leadership and mentoring, perform peer code reviews, and ensure the ServiceNow team follows software development best-practices Create/maintain API & data integration processes between ServiceNow and other services Work with Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) and Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) technologies in conjunction with ServiceNow Monitor health, usage, and overall compliance of the application Collaborate with ServiceNow Support concerning strategies and technical aspects of platform upgrades Oversee major version upgrades and installing patches Utilizing plug-ins for integrations and app development from ServiceNow application store and communities Strong experience in areas of Discovery and Orchestration supporting CMDB/Asset management initiatives, hands on experience with various data discovery sources like ITOM or SCCM Proven experience in understanding & capturing business requirements, streamlining complex business / IT processes, and help manage / deploy ServiceNow capabilities / features in an agile manner Coach and oversee the activities of Vendor resources on as-needed basis for project work Drives the creation of relevant and meaningful solution architectures, re-usable workflows, and other deliverables that enables the overall business thus driving better performance Validate all new change requests & demands on the platform Experience with setting standards for Mid server deployment assessing complex business requirements from real world scenarios and the ability to translate them into actionable target architectures, readily understood models and architectural plans Deep | Schneider Electric | Data Product Owner – Analytics | Bangalore | April 9, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | The Data Product Owner – Analytics plays a critical role in driving Schneider Electric’s data‑driven decision-making culture. This role leads the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of analytics products—primarily dashboards and insights solutions—across key business verticals such as Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. Acting as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, the Data Product Owner ensures that analytics products deliver actionable insights, are user‑centric, and support Schneider Electric’s broader Data & Performance mission of enabling performance management through trusted, scalable, and high-quality data. What will you do: Product Vision & Strategy Define and own the product vision for analytics solutions across Schneider Electric business functions. Translate high-level business requirements into use cases, user stories, and performance metrics. Become a trusted domain expert who advises business stakeholders on the right KPIs, data structures, and performance frameworks. Work closely with business leaders to identify decision-making needs, data pain points, and optimization opportunities. Stay continuously updated with BI and data trends to identify innovative features and improvements. Analytics Product Development Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of analytics products—from conception to deployment and iteration. Prioritize the product backlog based on business impact, user value, and technical feasibility. Oversee the design and structure of dashboards, ensuring clarity, relevance, and excellent UX for different user personas. Collaborate with data engineering and BI teams to ensure scalable data pipelines and efficient data models. Ensure content alignment with Schneider’s unified data layer, promoting consistency and data trustworthiness. Understand where Schneider’s data is stored, how it flows across systems, and how to effectively access datasets within the Schneider data ecosystem (data lake, reference data, APIs, BI layers, etc.). Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration Act as the main liaison between business teams (Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, etc.) and technical squads (data engineers, BI developers, UX designers). Lead workshops, requirement sessions, and demos to ensure stakeholder alignment. Provide clarity, guidance, and prioritization for technical teams throughout sprint cycles. Influence and convince stakeholders to adopt standardized dashboards, KPIs, and data practices. Build credibility so that business teams rely on the PO’s expertise when defining KPIs, performance logic, and analytical frameworks. User Experience & Adoption Ensure analytics solutions deliver intuitive, clean, and role-based user experiences. Drive adoption across geographies and business units through training, documentation, and communication campaigns. Conduct regular user feedback loops to refine dashboard features and functionality. Ensure seamless navigation, proper access control, and overall performance optimization. Data Quality, Governance & Security Promote and enforce data quality, consistency, lineage, and governance across analytics assets. Collaborate with governance and security teams to ensure compliance with PII, confidentiality, and global access rules. Support automation of data flows from source systems to dashboards using standardized processes. Innovation & Continuous Improvement Collaborate with platform owners and architects to explore AI-driven analytics, predictive modeling, and automation. Introduce new visualizations, BI components, and advanced analytics features as appropriate. Benchmark dashboard performance and drive iterative improvements based on usage insights. What will make you successful: 5–8 years of experience in analytics, BI product ownership, or digital product management. Strong background in data analytics concepts, KPI frameworks, and performance management. Demonstrated ability to become a trusted advisor to business teams for KPI definition and analytics decisions. Experience leading cross-functional agile teams and managing complex stakeholder landscapes. Qualifications: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or equivalent. Let us learn about you! Apply today.
