| Schneider Electric | Senior, ERP Technical Analyst | Bangalore | March 12, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Job Descriptions Job Title: Senior SAP Datasphere Consultant Experience: 6-10 years Location: Bangalore Responsibilities What will you do? Design, develop, and implement solutions using SAP Datasphere for enterprise data integration and analytics. Build and optimize CDS Views, ABAP SQL Services in S4 and Design and implement semantic data models in SAP Datasphere to support reporting and analytical requirements. Develop data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and harmonization of data from multiple sources. Configure Data Builder for creating tables, views, and transformations. Create and optimize CDS views for data extraction from SAP S/4HANA or ECC systems. Set up and manage Replication Flows for real-time and batch data synchronization. Set up task chains for automation of jobs Set up Data Access Control for data level authorizations. Build SQL based views Work with Data Integration Monitor to troubleshoot and optimize replication performance. Implement assessment of SAP roadmap and impact on Datasphere Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies and performance best practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud data with Datasphere for seamless data flow. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data modeling, performance tuning, and connectivity. Provide technical guidance and best practices for Datasphere implementation and usage. Work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. What skills and capabilities will make you successful? Strong hands-on experience with SAP Datasphere Expertise in CDS Views, ABAP SQL, and SAP S/4HANA data structures. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud integration scenarios. Proficiency in data modeling, ETL processes, and data virtualization concepts. Understanding of ODATA Connections and APIs for data extraction Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services preferred Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. What's in it for you? Opportunity to work on cutting-edge SAP Datasphere projects in a cloud-first environment. Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and advanced data integration technologies. Collaborative work culture with global teams and innovative projects. Who will you report to? Reports to SAP DataSphere Lead/SAP Technical Team Works closely with ERP technical teams, business analysts, and cloud integration specialists. Individual contributor role with potential to mentor junior consultants. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. 6–10 years of SAP ABAP experience with at least 2+ years in SAP Datasphere. Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and ABAP development concepts. SAP certification in Datasphere or related modules is a plus. | Schneider Electric | Lead - Manufacturing Apps Developer | Bangalore | February 17, 2026 | onsite | full-time | lead | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Title: Lead – MES Developer Location: Bangalore, KA Exp - 5-8 yrs We are seeking an experienced MES Developer with 5+ years of experience in MES Applications, particularly iTAC MES, to lead development, deployments & Run support across multiple factories. This role requires manufacturing process knowledge and proven ability to solve complex development, deployment & support challenges for a customized solution. Responsibilities: Lead global development & deployment of iTAC MES & other manufacturing applications across multiple manufacturing sites, ensuring timely and successful implementation. Manage global run support of iTAC MES & other manufacturing applications to ensure application stability and effectiveness. Collaborate with business and technical teams to understand factory-specific processes and tailor development & configurations accordingly. Develop and execute development, deployment & run support strategies, migration plans, and risk mitigation measures. Troubleshoot and resolve complex development, deployment & run support issues, ensuring minimal disruption to production operations. Coordinate with cross-functional teams (IT, Engineering, Operations) to ensure seamless integration with ERP, shop-floor systems, and IoT devices. Establish and enforce standardized development, deployment & run support methodologies and best practices. Provide technical leadership and guidance to regional teams and ensure knowledge transfer. Monitor progress, report KPIs, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards, data integrity, and regulatory requirements during deployments. Stay updated on manufacturing applications advancements and industry trends to recommend innovative solutions for global manufacturing operations. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering 5+ years of experience in MES development and implementation, preferably with strong expertise in iTAC MES. Proven track record of leading global or multi-site development, deployments & run support in discrete manufacturing environments. Deep understanding of manufacturing processes, architecture, and system integration. Strong problem-solving skills for addressing complex challenges. Proficiency in C#, VB, .NET, Angular, SQL server, Oracle DB, Integration technologies, and scripting for data migration and troubleshooting and familiarity with IoT connectivity. Exposure to Agile project methodology. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. | Schneider Electric | Principal, Services E2E Solution Lead | Bangalore | March 25, 2026 | onsite | internship | junior | Digital Innovation & Technology | Energy Management / Industrial Automation | Principal, Services E2E Solution Lead Exp 10 -12 yrs Location Bangalore Job Purpose The End-to-End Solution Lead is accountable for the overall functional and solution integrity of complex, multi-platform business solutions. The role owns the design, alignment, and delivery of end-to-end processes across CRM, Field Services, CPQ, and ERP systems—ensuring scalability, consistency, and business value. This role bridges business strategy, process design, and technical execution, providing single-point accountability for solution coherence across initiatives, releases, and geographies in large-scale Services and digital transformation programs. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Solution Ownership Own the end-to-end solution design across platforms including Salesforce, ServiceMax, CPQ, and ERP (SAP / Oracle). Define and govern future-state processes and system architecture for Services, Quote-to-Cash, and related domains. Ensure all functional and technical components align to a coherent, scalable E2E solution. Act as the single point of accountability for solution consistency across streams and teams. Architecture & Design Governance Lead cross-functional solution design workshops and deep dives. Validate and approve: Functional designs Integration designs Cross-system data flows Ensure adherence to global templates, reference models, and “fit-to-standard” principles. Identify and manage functional and architectural risks, trade-offs, and dependencies early in the lifecycle. Delivery Oversight & Lifecycle Management Oversee the full solution lifecycle: design → build → test → deploy → stabilize. Ensure cross-stream coordination across Salesforce, ERP, CPQ, and integration teams. Support release planning and go-live readiness from an E2E perspective. Act as escalation point for solution-related delivery issues and complex cross-platform defects. Integration & Cross-System Leadership Own the end-to-end integration vision across CRM, Field Services, ERP, and Finance systems. Ensure data consistency, process continuity, and clear ownership across system boundaries. Serve as the primary contact for cross-application and integration topics. Work closely with enterprise architects and middleware teams to validate integration patterns. Stakeholder & Program Leadership Act as a trusted solution advisor to senior business and digital leadership. Provide clear communication on solution choices, impacts, risks, and dependencies. Support governance forums, architecture boards, and leadership reviews. Drive alignment across internal teams and external implementation partners. Requirements Solution & Platform Expertise Strong experience designing end-to-end enterprise solutions across: Salesforce / ServiceMax CPQ platforms ERP systems (SAP ECC / S4HANA, Oracle) Deep understanding of Services and operational processes. Proven experience with multi-system global deployments and template-based rollouts. Professional & Leadership Skills Ability to operate at both strategic and detailed levels. Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent stakeholder management across business, IT, and leadership. Comfortable leading in ambiguity and driving alignment across complex organizations. Qualification ▪ Bachelor’s degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or related field. ▪ 8+ years of experience in solution design, architecture, or senior functional leadership roles. ▪ Experience in large-scale digital transformation or global template programs is a strong plus. Be a Digital Transformation Champion: This is your chance to be at the heart of our S/4HANA journey. Working within a dynamic team, you will drive the successful deployment of standardized, future-state S/4HANA processes, critically redefining how our business operates. You will take the lead in ensuring the effective adoption of SAP Best Practices, guaranteeing process consistency across global units, and building the foundational, clean-core system that supports our long-term growth.
